map: Inner GD and CG contract their respective initial errors.
The coupled warm-start errors are driven by outer displacement.
Choose D,N so that the error terms can be absorbed into outer descent.
Sum to obtain the average squared-gradient bound.

assumptions: g(x,·) is µ-strongly convex on the full space, with µ>0; f is jointly M-Lipschitz; ∇f and ∇g are jointly L-Lipschitz; g_xy is τ-Lipschitz and g_yy is ρ-Lipschitz; all derivatives exist; inf Φ>−∞; α∈(0,1/L], β=1/(8L_Φ); positive integers D,N satisfy δ_DN≤1 and (Ω+2ΩβL_Φ)δ_DN≤1/4; use the specified warm-start GD and CG.
statement.conclusion: (1/K)Σ_{k=0}^{K−1}||∇Φ(x_k)||² ≤ [64L_Φ(Φ(x0)−inf Φ)+5Δ_init]/K. For the target E||∇Φ||²≤ε², K must be at least the numerator above divided by ε². Retain the joint budget in K,D,N; do not add different call types without units.
statement.objects_and_definitions: Φ(x)=f(x,y*(x)), y*(x)=argmin_y g(x,y), κ=L/µ; v_k*=g_yy(x_k,y*(x_k))^{-1}∇_yf(x_k,y*(x_k)); Δ_init=||y0−y*(x0)||²+||v0−v0*||². L_Φ=L+(2L²+τ M²)/µ+(ρLM+L³+τML)/µ²+ρL²M/µ³, retained as printed in the source. Γ=3L²+3τ²M²/µ²+6L²(1+√κ)²(κ+ρM/µ²)²; δ_DN=Γ(1−αµ)^D+6L²κ[(√κ−1)/(√κ+1)]^{2N}; Ω=8(βκ²+2βML/µ²+2βLMκ/µ²)².
statement.parameter_domains: K,D,N≥1; the other public constants agree with the expressions above; κ≥1.
statement.quantifiers_and_randomness: Holds for every instance and initialization satisfying the assumptions, and every positive integer K. If the uniform output index b is independent of the deterministic trajectory, the same right-hand side bounds E||∇Φ(x_b)||².
